purpose: Demonstrate that context incompleteness in FinExam-10K is a missing-referent property of the source material, not a missing-field property of the release. Every record is structurally complete. A subset of records asks about background, usually a table or a shared vignette, that existed as an image in the source and was therefore not extracted. Those records carry an explicit flag and a description of what is absent, and they are excluded from the context-complete analyses in the paper rather than silently scored.
scope: released public partition, mock and practice items

defect_glossary.absent_table: the stem refers to a numeric table that was an image in the source and was not extracted
defect_glossary.absent_vignette: the item belongs to a shared case vignette that is not carried with it
defect_glossary.absent_labelled_object: the stem names a labelled figure, chart or panel that is not present
defect_glossary.option_mismatch: the options do not correspond to the quantity the stem asks for
defect_glossary.dangling_reference: the stem points at a referent that resolves to nothing in the source

context_completeness.note: missing_referent is free text written during adjudication, so its cardinality is high by design. It records what the stem points at, not a closed category.

context_complete_hard.why_shown: every field present and the stem is answerable from its own text. This is what the majority of the release looks like.
